positive_prompt: Elegant premium corporate event programme with strong visual hierarchy, sophisticated black and gold color palette, luxurious textures such as satin and velvet, soft ambient lighting creating a warm and opulent atmosphere, intricate gold patterns in the background, subtle metallic accents, and a clean minimalist layout with ample white space.
negative_prompt: Avoid clutter, busy patterns, bright neon colors, cartoonish elements, low quality textures, and any text or logos not specified in the event brief.
short_design_rationale: The design emphasizes elegance and sophistication through a refined black and gold palette, luxurious textures, and a minimalist layout that ensures a strong visual hierarchy and ample white space around content zones.
